workdirs.action.noValue: section_action's value cannot hold {key} (read takes no value)
workdirs.action.none: The kind of {path} ({kind}) has no actions
workdirs.action.notOfKind: The actions of a section of the kind {kind} are {ops} ({op} is not one)
workdirs.line.settings: Changed the settings of the working directory {name}
workdirs.settings.inBatch: readType, exclude, description and folder of a working directory's section are the project's settings (folder is this machine's binding), so a batch step cannot write them. Write them with section_update outside the batch
workdirs.settings.notWorkdir: {key} is a key of a working directory's section ({path} is not a working directory's section)
workdirs.write.directory: {path} is a directory of a working directory and is read only (it is made, renamed, moved and deleted in the folder; it is read again by section_action's op: read on the working directory's section)
workdirs.write.file: {path} is a file of a working directory and is read only (its name, content, lines and tags cannot be changed, and it cannot be deleted; only its place on the diagram, topLeft, can be written). A line to the file is drawn from a card of main or a branch, with {"line": "implementedBy", "to": "{path}"} in its connections
workdirs.write.onlyNote: Only notes (kind: note) can be put in a working directory's section ({path}). Create the {kind} in a section of a kind that holds it
workdirs.write.sectionInside: {path} is inside a working directory's section, so no section can be created there (the core makes the directories in it by reading the folder)
